DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のご相談でしょうか。なくした物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about lost property? Please tell me what you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 茶色の財布です。現金より、入れていたカードが使われないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 茶色の財布の紛失とカード不正利用への不安を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A brown wallet. More than the cash, I'm worried someone might use the cards inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report losing a brown wallet and your concern about unauthorized card use. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 財布を最後に見た場所と時刻はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where and when you last saw your wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午前十一時ごろ、駅前で買い物したときです。その後、かばんに戻したと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に財布を見た買物場所と時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around eleven this morning, when I was shopping in front of the station. I think I put it back in my bag afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where you were shopping and the time you last saw your wallet. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届け出の内容を確認します。カードについては、発行元へ連絡して対応を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the details of your report. For the cards, contact the issuers and ask what action to take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布の届け出とは別に、カード会社へ連絡するのですね。電話番号は自分で調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遺失物届けとカード会社への連絡を別の対応として確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: So contacting the card companies is separate from reporting the wallet lost. I'll look up the phone numbers myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that filing a lost-property report and contacting the card companies are separate actions. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、公式の連絡先を確かめてください。財布には身分を確認できる物も入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please make sure you use their official contact details. Was there anything in the wallet that could identify you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードも入っていました。番号を写したメモは家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布内の在留カードと番号メモの所在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My residence card was in it too. I have a note of the number at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your residence card was in the wallet and where your note of its number is. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も届け出に記録します。必要になる他の手続きは、関係する窓口で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record that in the report too. Let's check with the relevant offices about any other necessary procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 届け出を済ませたら、まずカード会社へ連絡します。在留カードについても確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届け出後に発行元と在留カード関係窓口へ確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I've filed the report, I'll contact the card companies first. I'll also check what to do about my residence card and proceed accordingly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to contact the card issuers and the office handling residence cards after filing the report. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、順番に記入をお手伝いします。それでは、こちらの席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll help you fill it in step by step. Please take this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱を発送されるのですね。古い送り状が残っているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're sending this box, correct? It looks like an old shipping label is still attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前届いた箱を使いました。新しい宛名を横に貼れば大丈夫だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再利用箱の古い送り状と新宛名の貼り方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I reused a box I received before. I thought putting the new address beside it would be all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the old shipping label on the reused box and how you intended to attach the new address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送り先を取り違えないよう、古い宛名や配送用の表示は外すか見えない状態にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: To avoid sending it to the wrong destination, let's remove the old address and delivery markings or make them invisible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古いラベルが破れて、住所の一部とバーコードだけ残っています。それも隠したほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残った旧住所とバーコードも隠すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The old label tore, leaving only part of the address and the barcode. Should I cover those too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the remaining old address and barcode should also be covered. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残った表示も読めないようにしてください。中身は何を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please make those remaining markings unreadable too. What's inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 洗った作業着です。液体や壊れ物は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送内容が洗った作業着で液体等がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Washed work clothes. There are no liquids or fragile items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the contents are washed work clothes and contain no liquids or similar items. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず古い表示を処理して、新しい送り状の宛先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Let's deal with the old markings first, then check the destination on the new shipping label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい住所には建物名がありません。家族に部屋番号と一緒に聞いてから書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 建物名と部屋番号を家族に確認してから記入すると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The new address doesn't include the building name. May I ask my family for that and the room number before filling it in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about checking the building name and room number with your family before writing them. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、不明な住所を推測せず、確認してから記入してください。箱はお手元でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, don't guess any address details you don't know; check before filling them in. Please keep the box with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この箱を持って一度外で連絡します。古い表示と新しい住所を直して戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を持って連絡し旧表示処理と住所補完後に戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the box outside and contact them. I'll come back after fixing the old markings and completing the new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll take the box to contact your family and return after dealing with the old markings and completing the address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: わかりました。準備ができたらお声がけください、それではお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Let us know when you're ready. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の操作でお困りですか。まだ実行はされていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble making a transfer? You haven't submitted it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。請求書に、振込名義へ契約番号を付けるよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 実行前の振込で契約番号付き依頼人名の指定があると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. The invoice says to add my contract number to the sender's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you haven't submitted the transfer and have been instructed to include the contract number in the sender's name. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手からの指定ですね。請求書の該当する部分を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the recipient's instruction, then. May I check the relevant part of the invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここです。番号を名前の前に付けるとありますが、口座番号と混同しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約番号の位置指定と口座番号を混同する不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. It says to put the number before my name, but I'm afraid I'll confuse it with the account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where the contract number should go and your concern about confusing it with the account number. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約番号と振込先の口座番号は別の情報です。振込依頼人名を入力する欄を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The contract number and the recipient's account number are different information. Let's check the field for the transfer sender's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この欄なら名前の前に契約番号を入れられそうです。振込先の番号は変更しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 依頼人名に契約番号を入れ振込先番号を変えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It looks like I can put the contract number before my name in this field. I won't change the recipient's account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll add the contract number to the sender's name and leave the recipient's account number unchanged. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、入力後の確認画面で、両方を別々に照合してください。金額と手数料も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, on the confirmation screen after entering them, check the two separately. You can also check the amount and fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 指定された文字が全部入るかも確認します。入り切らない場合は、支払先へ聞くべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定文字が欄に入り切らない場合の問い合わせ先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also check whether all the specified characters fit. If they don't, should I ask the payee?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whom to contact if all the specified characters won't fit in the field. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場合は実行せず、支払先に記載方法を確認してください。こちらで番号を省略して決めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: In that case, don't submit it. Ask the payee how to enter it. We can't decide here to leave out part of the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 省略はせず、請求書と確認画面を照合します。違いがあれば振込を止めて問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号を勝手に省略せず不一致なら振込を止めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't shorten it; I'll compare the invoice with the confirmation screen. If anything differs, I'll stop the transfer and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't shorten the number yourself and will stop the transfer if anything doesn't match. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番でお願いします。それでは、操作が終わる際は控えの取り忘れにもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that order. When you're finished, also take care not to leave your receipt behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計を始めますね。何か気になる商品がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll start ringing these up. Is there a product you're concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この卵の一つにひびが入っています。かごに入れるときは気づきませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計前に卵のひびを発見したと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: One of these eggs is cracked. I didn't notice when I put them in my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that you found a cracked egg before paying. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認しますので、パックを開けずにそのまま置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you leave the pack as it is without opening it so I can check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ開けていません。同じ商品に交換できるか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封のまま同一商品の交換確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I haven't opened it. Could you see whether I can exchange it for the same product?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about exchanging the unopened pack for the same product. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売場の在庫を確認します。ほかのお品物のお会計は先に進めてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the stock on the sales floor. May I ring up your other items first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。卵の分だけ、交換品が来てから金額に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他商品の会計を進め卵の計上だけ交換後にしてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Just wait to add the eggs to the total until the replacement arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the other items to be rung up, but the eggs to be added only after replacement. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。同じ商品が一つ見つかりましたので、こちらをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We found one of the same product, so please have a look at this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの卵はひびがなさそうです。このパックを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換品のひびを確かめそのパックの購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: These eggs don't seem to have any cracks. I'll buy this pack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the replacement for cracks and decide to buy that pack. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、こちらをお会計に入れます。お持ち帰りの袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll add this to your purchase. Do you have a bag to take them home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 布の袋を持っています。卵がつぶれないよう、重い物を先に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参袋と卵を守るための詰め方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a cloth bag. I'll put the heavy things in first so the eggs won't get crushed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you brought a bag and explain how you'll pack it to protect the eggs. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、卵を揺らしすぎないようお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take care on your way home not to jostle the eggs too much.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ワンちゃんを抱いていらっしゃいますね。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're holding your dog. Can I help with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: リードの金具が外れてしまいました。犬が走り出す前に抱き上げました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: リード金具が外れ犬を抱き上げたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The metal clip on the leash came undone. I picked my dog up before it could run off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the leash clip came undone and you picked up your dog. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: けがはありませんか。今は犬を放さず、落ち着ける所へ移りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are there any injuries? For now, don't let your dog go; let's move somewhere calm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: けがはなさそうです。ベンチで金具を見たいのですが、抱いたまま移動してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: けががない様子を伝え抱いたままベンチへ移れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There don't seem to be any injuries. I'd like to check the clip on a bench. May I move there while holding my dog?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there seem to be no injuries and ask about moving to a bench while holding your dog. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの空いているベンチへどうぞ。金具が壊れていたら、無理につなぎ直さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this empty bench. If the clip is broken, don't force it back on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金具のばねが戻りません。つなぎ直して散歩を続けるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ばねの故障を確認し散歩を中止すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The spring in the clip won't return. I won't reconnect it and continue the walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the spring is faulty and decide to stop the walk. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのほうがよさそうですね。安全に帰る方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That sounds best. Do you have a safe way to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に迎えを頼みます。抱いて待てますが、車で来る人にどこを伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の迎えを頼むため伝える入口情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask my family to pick us up. I can wait holding my dog, but what location should I tell the person coming by car?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what entrance information to give your family when requesting a pickup. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図の入口名を確認して伝えてください。車を園内へ入れず、送迎できる場所は現地の表示で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the entrance name on the information map and tell them. Don't bring the car into the park; let's check the signs here for a permitted pickup spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口名を家族に送ります。犬を抱いたまま待ち、合流したら今日は帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口名を送り犬を抱いて待ち合流後に帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll send my family the entrance name. I'll wait holding my dog, then go home with them when we meet up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll send the entrance name, wait holding your dog, and go home after meeting your family. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、迎えの場所まで移るときも周囲にご注意ください。それでは、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, watch your surroundings when moving to the pickup spot too. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車位置をお探しですか。どちらまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for where to board? Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の駅まで行きます。掲示と列車の前の表示が違うので、乗ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 掲示と車両表示の違いを伝えて隣駅へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: To the next station. The sign and the display on the front of the train differ, so I'm not sure whether I can board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the different platform and train displays and ask whether you can reach the next station. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いま表示を切り替えているところです。お持ちの切符を拝見して、列車も確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: They're changing the display now. I'll look at your ticket and check the train too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この切符です。発車時刻が近いのですが、確認が終わるまでここにいてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符を見せて発車前の確認中に待つ場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's my ticket. It's almost departure time; may I wait here until you've finished checking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and ask where to wait while the train is checked before departure. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この列車はまだ乗車案内の前です。黄色い線の内側でお待ちいただき、扉が開いても案内を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Boarding hasn't been announced for this train yet. Please wait behind the yellow line and listen for the announcement even if the doors open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。列車が来ているだけで乗車できるとは限らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着済みの列車でも乗車案内が必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. Just because the train is here doesn't necessarily mean we can board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that even a train that's arrived needs a boarding announcement. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、案内が出ましたね。こちらが目的の列車で、隣の駅にも停車します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, there's the announcement. This is the train you want, and it stops at the next station too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行き先表示も変わりました。隣の駅で降りるなら、この車両で大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目的の列車の停車駅と車両を改めて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The destination display has changed too. Is this carriage all right if I'm getting off at the next station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask again about the train's stops and the carriage for your destination. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この車両で大丈夫です。車内の停車駅表示でも駅名を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This carriage is fine. Please also check the station name on the stop display inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名を確認できました。案内が出たので、この列に並んで乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行き先表示と乗車案内を確かめて列に並ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed the station name. Now that boarding has been announced, I'll join this line and board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the destination display and boarding announcement, then join the line. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけて。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒についてのご相談ですか。宛名をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about the envelope? Have you checked the addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所は今の家ですが、知らない人の名前です。封は開けずに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅に届いた通知の宛名が知らない人だと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The address is my current home, but the name is someone I don't know. I brought it without opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the notice delivered to your home is addressed to someone you don't know. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差出人はこの市役所の担当課ですね。中身を開けず、宛先の状況をその課に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It was sent by a department in this city hall. Let's ask that department about the address without opening it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は先月入居しました。前に住んでいた人の通知かどうかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入居時期を伝えて以前の居住者か不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I moved in last month. I don't know whether the notice is for someone who lived there before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say when you moved in and that you don't know whether the person was a previous resident. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今お住まいの方と宛名が違うことを担当に伝えます。宛名の方の個人情報についてはお話しできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the person in charge that the name differs from the current resident's. We can't discuss the addressee's personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その人のことを知りたいわけではありません。私の書類と混ざらないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の情報ではなく自分の書類との混同を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not trying to find out about that person. I just don't want it getting mixed up with my documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid mixing it up with your own documents, rather than obtain someone else's information. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました、担当の窓口へつなぎます。お手元の封筒をそのまま見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll put you in touch with the relevant desk. Could you show them the envelope just as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、封筒ごと渡します。同じ名前の通知がまた来たときの連絡先も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封の封筒を示して再度届いた際の連絡先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll hand over the whole envelope. I'd also like to ask whom to contact if another notice for the same name arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the unopened envelope and ask whom to contact if another arrives. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、今後届いたときの扱いと問い合わせ先を確認してもらいます。あちらの窓口でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check what to do with any future deliveries and whom to contact. Please wait at that desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 開けたり捨てたりせずに相談します。今日はこの封筒を担当へ見せてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知を開封や廃棄せず担当窓口へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask without opening or throwing it away. Today I'll show this envelope to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult the responsible desk without opening or discarding the notice. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お足元に気をつけてお進みください。こちらでは失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please watch your step as you go. I'll leave you here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りのところですか。何かお忘れになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you on your way home? Did you forget something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い上着を診察の前に脱ぎましたが、かばんに入っていません。待合席に戻って探してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察前に脱いだ上着がないと伝えて待合席を探す相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took off my blue jacket before the examination, but it isn't in my bag. May I go back to look around the waiting seats?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your jacket removed before the examination is missing and ask to search the waiting seats. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 待合席は確認できますが、診察室へは勝手に入らないでください。どの辺りの席でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check the waiting seats, but don't enter the examination rooms on your own. Which seats were you near?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 壁際の一番奥です。番号を呼ばれて急いだので、背もたれに掛けたままかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上着を掛けたと思う待合席と置き忘れの状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the very back by the wall. I hurried when my number was called, so I may have left it on the backrest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which waiting seat you think you hung the jacket on and how you may have left it. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私がその席を確認してきます。内側に名前などの目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check that seat. Is there a name or other identifying mark inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前はありませんが、内側のポケットに白いハンカチが入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上着の内側のポケットにある目印を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: No name, but there's a white handkerchief in the inside pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the identifying item in the jacket's inside pocket. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 席には見当たりませんでしたので、預かり物も確認します。お帰りを急いでいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It wasn't at the seat, so I'll also check items handed in. Are you in a hurry to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 迎えの車が外にいます。少し待ってもらうので、ここで確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迎えの車を待たせて預かり物の確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My ride is outside. I'll ask them to wait a little, and wait here while you check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask your ride to wait while you wait for the handed-in items to be checked. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付に青い上着が届いていました。受付の方と、ポケットの中も一緒に確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: A blue jacket was handed in at reception. Please check inside the pocket together with the receptionist too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 特徴を受付で確認して受け取ります。迎えの人にも、見つかったと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付で上着の特徴を照合して迎えの人へ連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll verify its features at reception and collect it. I'll also tell the person picking me up it's been found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to match the jacket's features at reception and contact your ride. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかってよかったですね。どうぞお大事に、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad it was found. Take care of yourself and get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちになった袋は、拾われた物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the item in the bag you brought something you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道で鍵を拾いました。落とさないよう自分の袋に入れて、ここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の袋に入れて運んだ拾得鍵を届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a key on the sidewalk. I put it in my own bag so I wouldn't drop it, and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hand in a found key that you carried in your own bag. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます、鍵を確認します。どこで、何時ごろ拾いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. I'll check the key. Where and around what time did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分ほど前、川に近い横断歩道の手前です。場所の名前は分からないので地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾った時刻と目印を伝えて地図で場所を示す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: About ten minutes ago, just before the crosswalk near the river. I don't know the place name; may I show you on a map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the time and landmark where you found it and ask to show the place on a map. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この地図でお願いします。拾ったとき、鍵には何か付いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this map. Was anything attached to the key when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここです。小さな木の札が付いていましたが、名前や連絡先は見当たりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 拾得位置と鍵に付いた木札の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. It had a small wooden tag, but I couldn't see a name or contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain where you found it and the condition of the wooden tag attached to the key. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を記録しますね。鍵はお預かりし、拾った方の情報や手続きについてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record the location. We'll keep the key and explain the finder's information and procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手続きの説明をお願いします。この袋は私の物なので、鍵だけ預けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得手続きの説明を頼み自分の袋の返却を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please explain the procedure. This bag is mine, so I'd like to hand in only the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of the found-property procedure and for your own bag back. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鍵を取り出して、袋はお返しします。記録した拾得場所はこちらで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take out the key and return your bag. Is this the correct recorded location where you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、この交差点の川側で合っています。説明を聞いてから必要な欄を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録した拾得場所を確認して説明後に書類を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, on the river side of this intersection is right. I'll fill in the necessary fields after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the recorded location and say you'll complete the form after the explanation. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。お名前を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. May I check your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これは私宛てではありません。自分の郵便受けにあったのですが、隣の部屋の番号です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の郵便受けに入った不在票が隣室宛てだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This isn't addressed to me. It was in my mailbox, but it has the next room's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the missed-delivery notice put in your mailbox is for the neighboring room. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達について確認しますね。不在票の部屋番号と、ご自身の部屋番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the delivery. Please tell me the room number on the notice and your own room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 票は二〇二号室で、私は二〇一号室です。宛名の人には会ったことがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自室と不在票の部屋番号を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The notice says room 202; I’m in 201. I’ve never met the person named on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clearly distinguish your room number from the one on the notice. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました、宛名の方へ直接渡すのではなく、こちらで配達担当へ伝えます。票をお預かりできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Rather than asking you to give it directly to the addressee, we'll tell the delivery staff. May we keep the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。私の住所や名前も、確認のために必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤配の不在票を預けて確認に必要な自分の情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. Do you also need my address and name for the check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand over the misdelivered notice and ask what information about you is needed for verification. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず誤って入った郵便受けの場所を記録します。追加で確認が必要な情報は担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: First we'll record where the mailbox it was put into by mistake is. The person in charge will tell you if any further information is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 建物名はこちらです。入口に郵便受けが二列あるので、どちらの列かも書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 建物名と郵便受けの列を具体的に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here's the building name. There are two rows of mailboxes at the entrance, so I'll write which row too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the building name and specify the row of mailboxes. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました、配達担当へ渡します。ご自身の荷物の不在票もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've identified the location; I'll pass this to the delivery staff. Do you also have a notice for a parcel of your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はこの一枚だけです。隣室の荷物を私が受け取るつもりはないので、対応をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の不在票ではなく隣室の荷物を受け取らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only this one today. I don't intend to collect the next room's parcel, so please take care of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm this isn't your own notice and you won't collect the neighboring room's parcel. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お持ちいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for bringing it in. Get home safely.
